objectives.text: Steal the _mitem_ from _competitor_'s store, _storehouse_ in __storehouse_
Leave _qgiver_'s note anywhere inside _storehouse_
Bring the _mitem_ to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ within =2storehouse_ days
Or sell the _mitem_ to _competitor_ in ___competitor_ for a _gem_

branches.text: _competitor_ offers a _gem_ for the _mitem_ you stole.

outcomes.text: You sold the _mitem_ to _competitor_ for a _gem_, and _qgiver_ was left with nothing.
You turned down _competitor_'s _gem_ and brought the _mitem_ home to _qgiver_.
_qgiver_ has the _mitem_, and _competitor_ has the note.
The _mitem_ never reached _qgiver_ in time.

objectives.text: Return at least one of the four false gold bars to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ within =2mondung_ days
Recover the bar from the bank, _depository_ in __depository_
Recover the bar from _mansion_ in __mansion_
Recover the bar from the stronghold, ___mondung_
Recover the bar from the palace in __palace_

outcomes.text: All four false bars are back with _qgiver_, and not one ally is the wiser.
_qgiver_ won back some of the false gold before the allies found it out.
None of the false gold came back, and _qgiver_'s allies learned the truth.

objectives.text: Smuggle the _item_ to _contact_ at _conhouse_ in __conhouse_ within =queston_ days, and stay clear of the guard
Get past the knight lying in wait at _conhouse_
Or give the _item_ to _contact2_ at __contact2_ in ___contact2_

branches.text: The knight waiting at _conhouse_ will let you go if you hand over the _item_.

choices.text: Hand over the _item_ and walk away

outcomes.text: The _item_ reached _contact_, and the gold is yours.
_contact2_ took the _item_ off your hands and buried your part in the botched run.
You gave the _item_ up to the law at _conhouse_ and walked away.
You were too late to deliver, and the _item_ is still in your pack.
The _item_ never reached its buyer.

objectives.text: Take _qgiver_'s reply to _competitor_ in __competitor_
Fight the duel at _arena_ in __arena_ in _qgiver_'s name
Return to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_ for your reward

outcomes.text: The duel is won in _qgiver_'s name, and honor is restored, after a fashion.
_lover_ heard the whole sorry tale, paid you off, and left both cowards.
The duel was never fought.

objectives.text: Find _child_, said to be held by orcs in ___mondung_
Visit _knight_ at __knight_ in ___knight_ to hear the Fighters Guild's side
Find _child_ at _childlocale_ in __childlocale_, and decide who should keep the child
Bring _child_ home to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_ within =queston_ days

branches.text: _child_ is found. Will you take the child to _qgiver_?

outcomes.text: You took _child_ out of the Fighters Guild's keeping and back to _qgiver_, fortune and all.
_child_ is safe home with _qgiver_.
You left _child_ in the Fighters Guild's keeping, safe from _qgiver_.
_child_ never came home.

objectives.text: Take the ransom _gem_ to _kidnapper_ at __kidnapper_ in ___kidnapper_ within =2ransom_ days
Kill _kidnapper_'s thug and find out where _victim_ is held
Rescue _victim_ from ___mondung_
Return to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_

choices.text: Pay it as a friend of the Thieves Guild
Refuse, and get _victim_ back without it

outcomes.text: You brought _victim_ out of ___mondung_ yourself, and the ransom was never paid.
_victim_ is home, though the _gem_ is gone.
You paid the ransom as a friend of the Thieves Guild, and _victim_ came home.
You paid the ransom, and _victim_ came home.
_victim_ never came home.

objectives.text: Find _book_ in ___mondung_
Bring _book_ to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_ within =queston_ days

outcomes.text: _qgiver_ has _book_, and the rest of your fee is paid.
The days ran out before _book_ reached _qgiver_.

objectives.text: Find =enemy_ in ___mondung_ and beat the _enemy_ into surrender. _qgiver_ wants them alive.
Bring =enemy_ back to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_
Tell _qgiver_ in __qgiver_ that =enemy_ is dead

outcomes.text: =enemy_ stands before _qgiver_ alive, with a great deal of explaining to do.
=enemy_ is dead, and _qgiver_ paid the lesser fee.
=enemy_ got clean away.

objectives.text: Make the ransom fail: slay =cousin_ in ___mondung2_, or steal the _gem_ meant to pay it
Or seek out _victim_ in ___mondung_ and end it there
Return to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_ with the news, or with the _gem_, within =queston1_ days

branches.text: Three ways to make the ransom fail.

choices.text: Slay =cousin_, who means to pay it

outcomes.text: _victim_ will not be coming home. It was the best money _qgiver_ ever spent.
=cousin_ is dead, and no one is left to pay _victim_'s ransom.
You stole the ransom _gem_, and the ransom went unpaid without a drop of blood.
You kept the ransom _gem_ for yourself and never went back to _qgiver_.
The ransom was paid, and _victim_ came home.

objectives.text: Find the Bothdorjii Scroll in ___mondung_. A daedra guards it.
Destroy the fire atronach the scroll called forth
Bring the scroll to _qgiver_ in __qgiver_ within =queston_ days

branches.text: _qgiver_ will trade the truth about your shipwreck for a scroll that wakes the Princes' servants.

choices.text: Hand over the scroll and hear the truth about the storm
Burn it, for words that wake the Princes are better unread

outcomes.text: _qgiver_ has the Bothdorjii Scroll, and you know who sent the storm.
The Bothdorjii Scroll is ash, and the truth about the storm went unspoken.
The scroll never reached _qgiver_.

objectives.text: Kill some harpies in ___mondung_ and take a clan leader's dyed feather
Look for _contact_, the Fighters Guild mercenary lost in ___mondung_
Bring the feather to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ within =2mondung_ days

outcomes.text: The harpies are thinned, _qgiver_ has the proof, and _contact_ made it out alive.
The harpies are thinned, and _qgiver_ has proof of a civic effort.
No feather came back from ___mondung_, and _qgiver_ pays the fine.

objectives.text: Find where _patsy_ is hiding: ask at _bank_ in __bank_, or search the old home, _house2_ in __house2_
Bring ten gold to _hooker_ at _house1_ in __house1_ for what she knows
Talk to _gaffer_ at _tavern_ in __tavern_
Recover the deed, the gold _patsy_ borrowed, or _patsy_'s head
Return to _qgiver_ in ___qgiver_ for the diamond within thirty days

branches.text: _qgiver_ will take the deed, the gold, or _patsy_'s head, whichever you bring.

outcomes.text: The gold _patsy_ borrowed is back in _qgiver_'s coffers, and the loan is square.
_qgiver_ holds the deed, and _patsy_'s property with it.
_patsy_ is dead, and the debt is paid in blood.
_patsy_ got away with it all.
